Our capabilities include monitoring, managing, hosting, content workflow, and content creation for digital signage applications in a wide range of verticals. These services can be bundled with other YCD products or can be an a la carte element utilized in digital signage. We’ve created these service offerings to help our clients deploy their digital signage content seamlessly, and efficiently. These services work in tandem with our Cnario and RAMP products to allow clients an effortless way to deploy and manage their digital content assets. Bottom line… these services add value without adding the anxiety typically experienced in deploying and scaling digital signage projects. Proactive Monitoring Our Proactive Monitoring is designed to provide clients with ease of mind and maximum uptime for their system. This service includes an active software agent installed on each media player which provides ongoing reports, remote access, automatic alerts, and problem solving. We will monitor your digital signage network from anywhere. Content Management Our Content Management Service Program is a tailored solution to help our clients manage their digital signage networks. We offer managed services for any level of content management which includes everything from a full “send-it & forget-it”, to a partial client involved process. You choose the level, and we will provide simplified managed service on our platform. Hosting An all-inclusive Hosting Service for our Cnario and RAMP products. We offer both shared or dedicated servers to keep our clients content secured, and scalable. Templates The template package for Cnario or RAMP is tailored to provide a comprehensive solution for everyday messaging needs like Birthdays, Holidays, Employees of the Month, Weather, Traffic, News, Health and Wellness, and more. These templates are easy to purchase and bundled to complement all of our solutions. Workflow Customization Leveraging API’s and SDK’s we are able to build a customized workflow for all of your digital signage needs – from fully automated and integrated “hands-off” approach using a unique scheduling algorithm, to a simplified User Interface (UI) for uploading and scheduling content, we offer it all as a custom development service. Customized Content Our Customized Content development as an add-on for our software offering, with tailored content for any digital signage application. This includes brand specific content, triggered experiences, interactives, templates, dynamic feeds, HTML5, and much more. Yet, when we deploy a centrally managed content platform we harness the power of the network to be able to quickly deliver vital information such as safety instructions, weather data, and alert messaging to all screens. Campuses are ideal environments to benefit from this aspect of a centrally managed digital signage network. From sporting venues and stadiums, to cafeteria menu boards, indoor and outdoor signage, and wayfinding screens, a digital signage network can inform and assist faculty, students and visitors by distributing important passive or dynamic messaging.
